applies_to: Organisations that receive federal awards directly and have negotiated a rate with their cognizant agency
rate_or_limit: the rate, or rates, in the organisation's negotiated agreement; no single figure
set_by: 2 CFR 200.414(c)(1); Appendix III (institutions of higher education) and Appendix IV (non-profits) to 2 CFR part 200
status: In force. The eCFR text current to October 1, 2026, read October 4, 2026, requires all federal agencies to accept negotiated rates, with two exceptions.

rule: Limit on administrative costs inside a university's rate
applies_to: Institutions of higher education: the administrative categories of the facilities and administrative rate
rate_or_limit: 26% of modified total direct costs
set_by: Appendix III to 2 CFR part 200, section C.8
status: Standing rule in the record, read in the annual edition of the Code of Federal Regulations revised as of January 1, 2025.

applies_to: Recipients and subrecipients without a current federal negotiated rate, which includes many small non-profits
rate_or_limit: up to 15 percent of modified total direct costs; no documentation needed; may be used indefinitely
announced_or_effective: awards executed on or after October 1, 2024, as NSF states it
status: In force. The eCFR text current to October 1, 2026 carries the rate; NEH, IMLS, IES, HHS and USDA state 15 percent. One NIH text gives 10% (next row).

rule: De minimis rate as the NIH Grants Policy Statement text gives it
applies_to: NIH applicants with no federally negotiated rate
rate_or_limit: 10% of modified total direct costs, in the fetched policy text
set_by: NIH Grants Policy Statement, section 7.4
status: Disagrees with the row above. 2 CFR 200.414(f) and the HHS Grants Policy Statement give 15 percent; HRSA records a rise from 10 effective October 1, 2024.

applies_to: Foreign and international organisations on NIH and other HHS grants
rate_or_limit: 8 percent
base: modified total direct costs, as the NIH policy statement gives it
set_by: 2 CFR 300.414(b); NIH Grants Policy Statement, section 7.4
status: In the HHS regulation as read on eCFR, current to October 1, 2026.

applies_to: Training grants from HHS agencies; the HHS Grants Policy Statement includes career awards
rate_or_limit: 8% of modified total direct costs
status: In the HHS regulation as read on eCFR, current to October 1, 2026. It governs in place of the de minimis rate.

rule: NIH training, career and research education awards
applies_to: K awards, K12 programmes, T32 and T35 training grants and R25 research education grants
rate_or_limit: 8% of modified total direct costs, not the organization's negotiated rate
base: modified total direct costs; on training grants, exclusive of tuition and fees, consortium costs in excess of $25,000 and equipment
set_by: NIH parent notices PA-24-176 (K01), PA-27-030 (K12), PA-25-168 (T32) and PA-27-036 (R25)
status: As stated in the notices read. The R00 phase of the K99/R00 uses the institution's own rate.

rule: HRSA primary care research training grant (NRSA)
applies_to: HRSA's FY 2026 primary care National Research Service Award
rate_or_limit: 8% of modified total direct costs, whatever the institution's negotiated rate
set_by: Notice of Funding Opportunity HRSA-26-035
status: As stated in the FY 2026 notice.

applies_to: NIFA competitive awards; stated in the FY 2026 AFRI and Specialty Crop notices; sub-awardee indirect costs count
rate_or_limit: the lesser of the negotiated rate or 30 percent of Total Federal Funds Awarded
set_by: section 1462 of NARETPA (7 U.S.C. 3310)
announced_or_effective: standing rule; stated in FY 2026 notices
status: Statutory limit as the FY 2026 notices state it. NIFA's indirect costs page tells applicants to follow the limitation in each notice.

rule: NIH individual fellowships and conference grants
applies_to: NIH individual fellowships and NIH conference grants
rate_or_limit: none
set_by: NIH Grants Policy Statement, section 7.4; parent F31 notice PA-25-422
status: As stated in the policy text and the notice read.

rule: NIH S10 instrument awards and C06 construction awards
applies_to: S10 Shared Instrumentation and Seed Instrumentation Support awards; C06 research facility awards
rate_or_limit: none: S10 awards do not allow indirect costs; the C06 notice lists F&A costs as unallowable
set_by: NIH notices PAR-27-022 and PAR-27-021 (S10) and PAR-26-106 (C06)
status: As stated in the notices read.

rule: Department of Defense DURIP equipment awards
applies_to: DURIP awards, as the record reads the FY27 announcement
rate_or_limit: equipment costs are treated as exempt from indirect costs
set_by: FY27 DURIP NOFO N0001426SF003
status: As the record states it from the FY27 announcement.

rule: NIFA AFRI predoctoral and postdoctoral fellowships
applies_to: AFRI Education and Workforce Development predoctoral and postdoctoral fellowships
rate_or_limit: none: indirect costs are not permitted; a $3,000 per year institutional allowance is paid to the institution in their place
set_by: FY 2026 AFRI Education and Workforce Development Notice of Funding Opportunity
status: As stated in the FY 2026 notice.

applies_to: National Needs Graduate and Postgraduate Fellowship grants to institutions
rate_or_limit: none: indirect costs are not authorised; an institutional allowance is paid per fellow
set_by: FY 2026 National Needs Graduate and Postgraduate Fellowship Grants Program Notice of Funding Opportunity
status: As stated in the FY 2026 notice.

applies_to: The Knauss Marine Policy Fellowship and any costs associated with it
rate_or_limit: none: indirect costs are not allowable
set_by: FY 2027 Knauss Marine Policy Fellowship notice NOAA-OAR-SG-2027-32433
status: As stated in the FY 2027 notice.

applies_to: NHPRC grant recipients, as the documentary editions announcement states
rate_or_limit: none: grant funds may not be used for indirect costs
set_by: 2 CFR 2600.101, as the NHPRC announcement EDITIONS-202505 indicates
status: As stated in the FY 2026 announcement, which is closed.

applies_to: REU Site proposals and Supplement requests: the budget category that holds student stipends, housing and travel
rate_or_limit: no indirect costs may be recovered on participant support costs
set_by: NSF 23-601 program solicitation
status: As stated in the solicitation read.

applies_to: All NIH grants, as the notice states, in place of negotiated rates
rate_or_limit: 15 percent, in place of a negotiated rate
set_by: NIH notice NOT-OD-25-068, Supplemental Guidance to the 2024 NIH Grants Policy Statement
status: Vacated. District of Massachusetts enjoined it March 5, 2025, later permanently, and vacated the notice; First Circuit affirmed January 5, 2026. An association reports no Supreme Court petition was filed.

applies_to: DOE grant awards to institutions of higher education
rate_or_limit: a standardized 15 percent indirect cost rate
set_by: DOE Policy Flash 2025-22
status: Vacated. District of Massachusetts enjoined it May 15, 2025, vacated it June 30, 2025. DOE: no longer in effect from January 23, 2026. Association timeline: appeal dismissed March 16, 2026.

applies_to: DOE awards to state and local governments, non-profits and for-profit organisations; indirect and fringe benefit reimbursement
rate_or_limit: figure not given in the record
announced_or_effective: 2025; dates not given in the record
status: Withdrawn. DOE Policy Flash 2026-30 of January 27, 2026 states they are no longer in effect from January 23, 2026, citing Section 313 of H.R. 6938.

rule: ARPA-E notice clause limiting indirect costs
applies_to: Open ARPA-E programme notices; the example in the record is the CATALCHEM-E notice, DE-FOA-0003505
rate_or_limit: indirect cost cap at 15% of Total Project Costs
set_by: the Maximum Limit on Indirect Costs clause of the ARPA-E notices
status: Removed from open notices by modification; in the CATALCHEM-E notice by Modification 03 of February 6, 2026.

applies_to: New NSF awards to institutions of higher education issued on or after May 5, 2025; not retroactive
rate_or_limit: a rate no greater than 15% of modified total direct costs
set_by: Policy Notice NSF 25-034
status: Vacated and declared invalid June 20, 2025, District of Massachusetts. A case summary records NSF's appeal dismissed on its own motion September 30, 2025. Not in effect.

applies_to: New and existing Department of Defense assistance awards to institutions of higher education
rate_or_limit: indirect cost rates capped at 15%
set_by: memorandum from the Secretary of Defense and memorandum from the Under Secretary of Defense for Research and Engineering
status: Vacated and enjoined. District of Massachusetts enjoined it July 18, 2025; vacated it and made the injunction permanent October 10, 2025. Plaintiff association: Government's appeal dismissed February 18, 2026.

rule: Appropriations provisions that keep negotiated rates
applies_to: NIH (section 224); DOE (section 313); NASA, Commerce and NSF (section 542, from a consultant's note; statutory text not reached)
rate_or_limit: no rate set: the indirect cost rules, including approval of deviations from negotiated rates, apply as in an earlier year (NIH: third quarter of fiscal year 2017; DOE: fiscal year 2024)
set_by: Public Law 119-75, section 224; H.R. 6938, sections 313 and 542; continued by Public Law 119-103
status: In force through December 11, 2026: Public Law 119-103 continues the fiscal year 2026 acts with their conditions. What follows depends on the fiscal year 2027 acts.

rule: Proposed revision of the Uniform Guidance on facilities and administrative costs
applies_to: Discretionary grants, as Executive Order 14332 defines them
rate_or_limit: no figure: the order directs OMB to limit the use of discretionary grant funds for facilities and administrative costs
set_by: Executive Order 14332, section 5; OMB proposed rule, 91 FR 32198
status: Proposed; no revision has taken effect. An association summary says the proposal leaves negotiated rates unchanged. Public Law 119-103, section 157, bars a final rule through December 11, 2026.

rule: NIH fiscal year 2027 budget request: cap on F&A costs
applies_to: Each NIH award, under the request
rate_or_limit: 15 percent of the applicable direct cost base for each award
set_by: FY 2027 President's Budget (NIH congressional justification)
status: A budget request, marked proposed in the ledger. Section 224 of the FY 2026 appropriations act keeps the indirect cost provisions of 45 CFR part 75 applying to NIH grants.
